title: Happy Path
narrative: A single pick-carry-place cycle in a well-conditioned region: the pipeline sees no risk and keeps the Direct realization.

title: Multi-Object
narrative: Two boxes, two trays: several operations composed in sequence, every one executed.

title: Repair Alternatives
narrative: A constrained carry hugs the workspace limit; risk is detected and an admissible repaired realization is selected.

title: Safety Rejection
narrative: A target outside the workspace envelope: no admissible realization exists, so Thalos refuses to execute.
